# graviteeam_analytics (Data Source)

Reads analytics data from a Gravitee AM domain

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graviteeam_analytics" "example" {
  domain_id = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  type      = "COUNT"
  field     = "application"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain to read analytics from
- `type` (String) Analytics type: DATE_HISTO, COUNT, or GROUP_BY

### Optional

- `field` (String) Aggregation field
- `from` (Number) Start timestamp (milliseconds)
- `interval` (Number) Histogram interval (milliseconds)
- `size` (Number) Number of results to return
- `to` (Number) End timestamp (milliseconds)

### Read-Only

- `result` (String) JSON string containing the analytics result (structure varies by type)
